newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla cattle actively traded at $63.00-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla cattle actively traded at $63.00-USDA.

text.p: Trade fairly active in the panhandle area early Tuesday.
Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 4,000 slaughter steers and 1,000 heifers; 53,100 head confirmed for the week to date including 18,800 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00.
